mobile.name: mobile
mobile.description:
Tool for interacting with a mobile device.
Coordinates are integer pixels in [0, 704] for x and [0, 1472] for y.

tap.name: tap
tap.description: Taps at the specified coordinates on the mobile screen.

swipe.name: swipe
swipe.description: Swipes from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2) on the mobile screen.

type_text.name: type_text
type_text.description: Types the specified text on the mobile device.

answer.name: answer
answer.description: Responds to the user if the user asked a question or if it needs to proactively inform the user about something important

navigate.name: navigate
navigate.description: Presses an Android soft key on the mobile device.

key.description: The Android soft key to press: home, back, or enter

status.name: status
status.description: Reports a current status that makes other actions not possible to make

key.description: Reasons to not output a concrete action on the UI
